2124518657992577327.author: AdamSchefter
2124518657992577327.text:
Tom Jackson, a foundational player on the Denver Broncos' "Orange Crush" defense and a fixture at ESPN as a Hall of Fame broadcaster in his post-NFL career, has died. He was 75.
 
Jackson's family informed ESPN of his death. A fourth-round pick by the Broncos in the 1973 draft out of Louisville, Jackson played in 191 regular-season games, including 177 starts. He also played in 10 playoff games over 14 seasons with the Broncos.
 
For many football fans, however, Jackson's second career act was how they knew him. He had a 29-year run at ESPN and was a mainstay alongside Chris Berman.
